Full summary: Task 9 (inline): Decisions table replaced with the shared virtualized list (status/domain/confidence facets, superseded strikethrough, rich detail via window.renderDecisionDetail bridge). Browser-verified at 5k: 22 DOM rows, facet counts match fixture (4619 active/381 superseded), zero console errors. PHASE 2 COMPLETE.
Decisions: Preserved renderDecisions' hidden side effect (timeline refresh on fresh data) by moving it into fetchDecisions when deleting the function — the timeline still renders from legacy state until Phase 3 replaces it.; Reused app.js's renderDecisionDetail for the new list's detail panel via the classic-script window bridge instead of porting ~180 lines now — it ports in Phase 5 when navigateToId is replaced by routing; porting twice would create drift risk.
